name: EEG Transfer and Psychopathology Prediction
description: Develop models for zero-shot decoding of cognitive tasks from EEG data and predicting latent psychological constructs as biomarkers for mental health.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: EEG data in the form of 2-second epochs (128 channels x time steps), along with demographic attributes (age, gender, handedness) for Challenge 1, and event-level annotations for Challenge 2.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Continuous predictions for response time in Challenge 1 and continuous scores for internalization, externalization, attention, and the p-factor in Challenge 2. Values are expected to be within the range of observed data distributions.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for each sample, e.g., eeg_sample_001

field.name: pred
field.description: predicted value for response time or psychopathology factors, depending on the challenge

cr:evaluation.notes: nRMSE is computed as RMSE divided by the standard deviation of the true labels. Overall ranking is a weighted combination of nRMSE scores for the two challenges.
